mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at partly cloudy conditions with a temperature of 61 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park and a First Quarter moon overhead.
The city has released the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to guide future growth, and the police department is currently accepting applications for new patrol officers.
We have a busy schedule starting with live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival or visit the Dane County Farmers' Market.
In our weekly recap, on September 5, an officer discovered multiple vehicles with slices of cheese on their windshields as part of a viral social media prank.
The Culver's of Verona is currently undergoing a remodel and is closed today, but the team will be back in action and ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
